commit.blocked.amend_not_edited: HEAD isn't the commit being edited, so amending would change an earlier commit. This commits the changes as a new commit.
commit.blocked.clean: Nothing to commit. The working tree is clean.
commit.blocked.conflicts: Resolve the conflicted files before staging everything.
commit.blocked.merge_conflicts: Resolve every conflict before committing the merge.
commit.blocked.nothing_staged_key: Stage changes to commit, or press {key} to stage all and commit.
commit.blocked.nothing_to_amend: Stage a change or edit the message to amend the commit, or use Continue.
commit.blocked.unencodable: This repository writes commit messages in {encoding} (i18n.commitEncoding), which can't hold {chars}. Remove them from the message.
commit.blocked.untouched_template: Edit the commit template before committing.
commit.continue_skipped.log: Continuing the rebase after committing was skipped: that repository's tab is no longer active.
commit.identity.env.tip: Set in Glowfly's environment: {vars}. Git uses these in place of user.name and user.email when you commit. To commit with the identity in your Git config, unset them and start Glowfly again.
commit.link_tip.link: Adds a link to the description
commit.link_tip.mention: Adds the mention to the description
commit.more.skipping_tip: More commit options. Hooks are skipped for this commit.
commit.push_after.detached: Nothing to push from a detached HEAD
commit.push_after.tip: After a successful commit, push the branch. A branch with no upstream is pushed to the default remote and tracks it.
commit.shortcuts.all_only: {all} stages all changes and commits from the message fields.
commit.shortcuts.both: {commit} commits from the message fields; {all} stages all changes first.
commit.skip_hooks.tip: Commit with --no-verify: the pre-commit and commit-msg hooks don't run.
commit.summary_count.tip: Summaries read best in 50 characters or fewer; past 72 they get cut off in logs and on hosting services.
commit.template_note: The template's lines starting with {char} are left out of the message
